news.title: Marchand exits Panthers' win in 2nd period with leg injury
news.ruTitle: Маршан пропустил победу "Пантеров" во втором периоде из-за травмы ноги
news.description: Panthers forward Brad Marchand, who just made his season debut Sunday night, sustained a left leg injury in the second period of his club's 2-1 victory over the Kings on Tuesday night and was helped off the ice by his teammates.

news.title: Golden Knights beat Kraken 6-2 behind 2 goals each from Olofsson and Hertl
news.ruTitle: «Голден Найтс» обыграли «Кракена» со счетом 6:2, забив по два гола Олофссону и Хертлю.
news.description: — Victor Olofsson and Tomas Hertl scored two goals apiece and the Vegas Golden Knights beat the Seattle Kraken 6-2 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Mammoth's Mikhail Sergachev exits after taking puck to helmet
news.ruTitle: Игрок «Мамонта» Михаил Сергачев уходит после попадания шайбы в шлем
news.description: Utah Mammoth defenseman Mikhail Sergachev left Tuesday night's 5-3 win over New Jersey after being struck on the back of the helmet by a puck.

news.title: Rinzel and Frondell score, Blackhawks beat Blues 4-2 in Kane's return to Chicago
news.ruTitle: Ринзель и Фронделл забивают, «Блэкхокс» обыграли «Блюз» со счетом 4–2 в возвращении Кейна в Чикаго
news.description: — Sam Rinzel and rookie Anton Frondell scored 2 minutes apart in the second period and the Chicago Blackhawks held on in their home opener for their first win of the season, 4-2 over the St. Louis Blues on Tuesday night.

news.title: Taylor Hall scores 2 as Hurricanes beat Canadiens 6-4 in Montreal's home opener
news.ruTitle: Тэйлор Холл забил 2 гола, когда «Харрикейнз» обыграли «Канадиенс» со счетом 6:4 в первом домашнем матче «Монреаля»
news.description: — Taylor Hall scored twice as the Carolina Hurricanes beat Montreal 6-4 in the Canadiens' home opener on Tuesday night.

news.title: Matthews scores OT winner, McKenna gets his first NHL goal, as Maple Leafs beat Predators 5-4
news.ruTitle: Мэтьюз забивает победный гол в овертайме, Маккенна забивает свой первый гол в НХЛ, а «Мэйпл Лифс» обыграли «Предаторз» со счетом 5–4
news.description: — Auston Matthews scored with 14 seconds left in overtime and had three assists in regulation and the Toronto Maple Leafs erased a three-goal deficit in a 5-4 win over the Nashville Predators on Tuesday night.

news.title: Nick Schmaltz scores NHL-best 5th goal and Mammoth beat Devils 5-3
news.ruTitle: Ник Шмальц забивает лучший пятый гол в НХЛ, а Мамонт обыграл Девилз со счетом 5–3
news.description: — Nick Schmaltz scored his NHL-best fifth goal of the season, and the Utah Mammoth relied on their proficient power play to beat the New Jersey Devils 5-3 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Larkin scores in return to lineup as Red Wings deal Senators 1st loss of the season 5-3
news.ruTitle: Ларкин забивает, вернувшись в состав, а «Ред Уингз» нанесли сенаторам первое поражение в сезоне 5–3
news.description: — Dylan Larkin scored in his first game since asking for a trade, helping the Detroit Red Wings to a 5-3 win over the Ottawa Senators on Tuesday night.

news.title: Larkin feels 'lot of emotions' in season debut as Wings win
news.ruTitle: Ларкин испытывает «много эмоций» в дебютном сезоне после победы «Уингз»
news.description: Cheered by the same crowd that booed him last week, Dylan Larkin played for Red Wings for the first time since asking for a trade and scored 13 minutes into his return Tuesday, as Detroit posted a 5-3 win over the Ottawa Senators at Little Caesars Arena.

news.title: Owen Power scores in OT and Sabres rally from 2 goals down to beat Wild 3-2
news.ruTitle: Оуэн Пауэр забивает в овертайме и розыгрыше «Сэйбрз» с разницей в 2 гола и побеждает «Уайлд» со счетом 3–2.
news.description: — Owen Power scored 4:22 into overtime and the Buffalo Sabres rallied from a two-goal deficit to beat the Minnesota Wild 3-2 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Maple Leafs' Gavin McKenna has goal, assist against Predators
news.ruTitle: Игрок «Мэйпл Лифс» Гэвин МакКенна забил гол и сделал результативную передачу в матче с «Хищниками»
news.description: No. 1 draft pick Gavin McKenna scored his first NHL goal with the Maple Leafs on Tuesday night.

news.title: Winless Philadelphia Flyers add depth in Michael Bunting
news.ruTitle: Без побед «Филадельфия Флайерз» добавили глубины Майклу Бантингу
news.description: The winless Philadelphia Flyers added to their forward group Tuesday, signing veteran winger Michael Bunting, 30, in the hopes that he can give them a spark following some alarming early season struggles, including scoring just five goals in four games.
